applied.problem: "The point sits straight above it" and "go up to the graph" fail for outputs below zero (i3's cube and one-over, i6's flip); "3 cm across" is from the centre; not every axis has a unit; position-against-position graphs only can look like the thing.
"Go straight up to the graph" and "come down" fail when the graph is below the input axis, as for outputs under zero in i3 and after i6's flip; the steps should work for any function graph.
While the pen is lifted there is no reading at those moments, so "still one reading for each moment" is false; the true point is that it never shows two readings for one moment.
